sn35.144:1.1: Rūpā bhikkhave dukkhā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rupānam uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto sukhā bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā dukkhā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo dhammānam uppādāya so pi dukkho || dukkhasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto sukhā bhavissanti || || Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
